text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I will be serving as your guide. My name 
is Satono Diamond. It is an honor to 
assist you.

text_block_list.name: French Inspection Delegation
text_block_list.text:
To be shown around by an active racer like 
Dia-san and her Trainer! It's such an 
honor!

At the request of Satono Diamond's father, 
I am giving a tour of the academy to a 
visiting exchange delegation today. 
Apparently, they are trainers from France.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then, let us head to the training track 
first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"This is the training course. Usage during 
afternoon training hours requires a 
reservation, so—"

text_block_list.name: French Inspection Delegation
text_block_list.text: All the students training here? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Surprising, isn't it? From what I hear, 
the training facilities in France are 
pretty massive.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I heard an inspection team is visiting? 
I'll help guide them around too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Who cares where it is?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So you have an interest in overseas! 
Please, do let me accompany you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The compulsory training curriculum also 
includes swimming. The pool length is 50 
meters—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The dormitories are divided into the Ritto 
and Miho dorms. Meals, cleaning, and other 
upkeep are handled by the dormitory staff—

text_block_list.name: French Inspection Delegation
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you very much for today. This will 
be a great reference for my expedition to 
Japan! Farewell for now.”

The car carrying the inspection delegation 
disappears from view. I breathe a sigh of 
relief... but beside me, Satono Diamond 
wears a grave expression.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I was remembering the stories about 
France that the members of the delegation 
shared with us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've come to realize that the training 
environment is quite different from 
Japan's...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The stuff we really wanna know isn't 
written down in everyday info, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's just like the track. You won't know 
how it really feels until you actually run 
on it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If that's the case, I thought that 
the Umamusume over there might similarly 
be unfamiliar with the environment in 
Japan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
............ ――Trainer, Sirius-san. Would 
you mind accompanying me for a moment?

Satono Diamond brought me to Tokyo 
Racecourse. Under the supervision of URA 
staff, we were permitted entry into 
certain restricted areas.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—So, what're we doing here when there 
isn't even a race today?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's video recording. The footage is 
planned to be used as material for the VR 
Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will develop a VR Umulator software 
for overseas expedition simulations!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Talking with the inspection team made me 
realize it all over again. When traveling 
abroad, there must be many Umamusume who 
fail to perform at their best simply 
because they cannot adjust to the new 
environment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I want to eliminate such disadvantages. 
Therefore, I decided to create a tool that 
helps them adapt to away environments!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're as wild as ever! Replicating 
everything with the Umalator, from 
training during the stay all the way to 
running the race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We plan to obtain official permission 
to film on the track under the Satono 
corporate name.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of doing some overseas shoots 
down the line too. Starting with France, 
of course!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"If more of us race abroad, the entire 
racing world will thrive. As an Umamusume 
of the Satono family, I want to do 
everything I can!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, how passionate. Not bad, though. 
If going overseas becomes more common, 
we'll see far more thrilling races.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Fine by me. I'll dance with you too. 'May 
I have this hand, milady?' or something 
like that."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! As active Umamusume, 
I believe there are certain things only we 
can notice. Please do share your thoughts 
with us!

To bring excitement to the global racing 
world—as a racing Umamusume of the Satono 
family, Satono Diamond's grand challenge 
had begun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-san! Thanks to you, full-scale 
development on the expedition simulation 
software has officially begun!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see. Once it's finished, let's dance the 
night away with the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, that's right. Please make good use 
of it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Also, the French inspection team sent 
their thanks. You recommended the 
good-luck charms as souvenirs, didn't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean the charm from that shrine 
near the academy, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, then maybe we'll see more Umamusume 
coming to Japan just to get charms.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In whatever way it happens, I'd be so 
happy if more Umamusume go on overseas 
expeditions!
